SHARED-F-2-S87.title: Consent Data Schema and Tier Contract Definition
SHARED-F-2-S87.description: Define and implement the data schema and contract for two-tier HIPAA consent, including Tier 1 (de-identified usage) and Tier 2 (identified storage). Ensure schema supports auditability, timestamping, and linkage to session/user context.

SHARED-F-2-S88.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Enforcement
SHARED-F-2-S88.description: Implement core consent logic enforcing Tier 1 vs Tier 2 behavior, including de-identification workflows, consent escalation, and storage gating. Ensure all downstream services receive consistent consent decisions.

SHARED-F-2-S89.title: Consent Framework Test Coverage
SHARED-F-2-S89.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, de-identification correctness, API behavior, and cross-service integration scenarios (lead capture, unknowns, tool routing).
